answer:
根据文档第 2 页的 **Fig. 1. Technology tree of RAG research**（RAG 研究技术树图），该树形图包含三大主干分支，分别对应 RAG 涉及的三个阶段：

| 分支名称 | 叶节点（方法名）数量 |
|---|---|
| **Pre-training（预训练）** | 4 个 |
| **Fine-tuning（微调）** | 23 个 |
| **Inference（推理）** | 38 个 |

其中 **Pre-training（预训练）** 分支的叶节点最少，仅有 **4 个**，分别是：InstructRetro、RAVEN、CoG、Retro++。

> 引用：PDF 物理页码 **第 2 页**，Fig. 1 及其图注。

tool_calls.name: read_parsed_pdf
read_parsed_pdf
tool_calls.args: {"action":"inspect_page","document_id":"doc_dad40f13db97b86b02b8","mode":"figure","page":2,"query":"Count the exact number of method names (leaves) on each of the three branches: Pre-training, Fine-tuning, and Inference. List them and give the count for each branch."}

tool_calls.name: read_parsed_pdf
tool_calls.args: {"action":"inspect_page","document_id":"doc_dad40f13db97b86b02b8","mode":"text","page":2,"query":"list all method names on each branch of the tree: Pre-training, Fine-tuning, Inference"}

tool_calls.name: execute_code
tool_calls.args:
{"code":"
pre_training = ["InstructRetro", "RAVEN", "CoG", "Retro++"]
fine_tuning = ["UniMS-RAG", "CT-RAG", "BEQ", "CoN", "EAR", "RAST", "Dual-Feedback-ToD", "Self-RAG", "LM-Indexer", "RA-DIT", "SANTA", "SUGRE", "AAR", "FLARE", "RRR", "Self-Mem", "UPRISE", "R-GQA", "Zemi", "Atlas", "RAG-e2e", "PROMPTAGATOR", "RAG"]
inference = ["G-Retriever", "CRAG", "IAG", "FILCO", "ARM-RAG", "PRCA", "Token-Elimination", "KALMV", "ITRG", "KGP", "LLM-R", "ITER-RETGEN", "LLM-IE", "COQ", "ICRALM", "DSP", "GenRead", "RECITE", "RADA", "RAPTOR", "BGM", "HyKGE", "PaperQA", "DRAGON-AI", "CREA-ICL", "1-PAGER", "FABULA", "ToC", "QLM-Doc-ranking", "SKR", "Recomp", "KnowledGPT", "IRCOT", "PGRA", "PKG", "SCM4LLMs", "Filter-Retanker", "RePLUG"]

print(f"Pre-training: {len(pre_training)} leaves")
print(f"Fine-tuning: {len(fine_tuning)} leaves")
print(f"Inference: {len(inference)} leaves")

counts = {"Pre-training": len(pre_training), "Fine-tuning": len(fine_tuning), "Inference": len(inference)}
min_branch = min(counts, key=counts.get)
print(f"\nBranch with least leaves: {min_branch} ({counts[min_branch]} leaves)")
","lang":"py"}
